编码助手总结（Codex / Claude Code）: Summary by the coding assistant (Codex / Claude Code)
一轮结束立即播报「项目名 + 这一轮指令的第一句」，不调用任何模型。: Speaks “project + the first sentence of your prompt” the moment a round ends; no model is called.
让完成这一轮的 Codex 或 Claude Code 自己用一句话说明结果，用: The Codex or Claude Code that finished the round says in one sentence what it achieved, on your existing sign-in with no key; the notice comes about ten seconds later, with one more model call per round.
把这一轮的最终回复发给云端模型，总结成一句话再播报，通常只需几秒；需要 API: Sends the round’s final reply to a cloud model to be put in one sentence, usually within seconds; needs an API key, and the reply is sent to the provider you choose.
用本机或局域网里部署的小模型总结（Ollama、vLLM、LM Studio、l: A small model served on this machine or your network (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, llama.cpp and the like) writes the sentence; nothing leaves your devices, and the first call may be slow while the model loads.
模型名称，可点右侧获取: Model name; the button lists them
找到 {count} 个模型，可在模型框里选择。: Found {count} models; pick one in the model field.
接口没有返回模型列表，请手动填写模型名称。: The server returned no model list; type the model name.
已保存，输入新密钥可替换: Saved; type a new key to replace it
密钥已加密保存在本机。: The key is saved, encrypted, on this machine.
一句话总结用 1–3B 的小模型就够，例如 qwen2.5:1.5b、qwen2: A 1–3B model is enough for a one-sentence summary, for example qwen2.5:1.5b, qwen2.5:3b, gemma2:2b or phi3:mini.
请先填写 API 密钥。: Fill in the API key first.
云端接口必须使用 https 地址。: A cloud API must use an https address.
接口地址无效，请填写完整地址，例如 http://localhost:11434: That is not a valid API address; give the full address, for example http://localhost:11434/v1
模型接口超时，没有在限定时间内回答。: The model did not answer in time.
模型接口返回的不是 JSON，请检查接口地址。: The server did not return JSON; check the API address.
模型没有给出可用的总结。: The model gave no usable summary.
API 密钥格式不正确。: That does not look like an API key.
此系统无法加密保存密钥，未保存。: This system cannot encrypt the key, so it was not saved.
编码助手没有给出总结：可能未安装、未登录，或超过了 30 秒。: The coding assistant gave no summary: it may not be installed or signed in, or it took over 30 seconds.
终端、会话恢复与编辑器: Terminals, session restore and the editor
点击按键后按下新的组合；Esc 取消。: Click a key, then press the new combination; Esc cancels.
留空使用简短的默认播报，如：{example}: Leave empty for the short default notice, such as: {example}
给 {agent} 发消息，Enter 发送，Shift+Enter 换行: Message {agent}; Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
阅读视图：按文档排版显示对话: Reading view: the conversation laid out as a document
GPU 加速：用显卡绘制终端文字，助手工作时处理器占用低得多；如果终端显示异常，: GPU: the graphics card draws terminal text, so a working assistant uses far less processor time. If terminals look wrong, use Compatible.
启动 Codex 或 Claude Code 后才能粘贴图片。: Start Codex or Claude Code before pasting images.
已附加 {count} 张图片，随下一条消息发送: {count} image(s) attached; they go with the next message
给 {agent} 发消息，/ 查看命令，Enter 发送，Shift+Ente: Message {agent}, / for commands, Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
这个项目还没有其他 Claude 会话: This project has no other Claude sessions yet
↑/↓ 选择 · Enter 恢复 · Esc 取消: ↑/↓ to select · Enter to resume · Esc to cancel
无法读取这个 Claude 会话的历史。: Could not read the history of this Claude session.
高精度 · 中英混合: High accuracy · mixed Chinese and English
批准自动审查拒绝后的重试: Approve a retry after auto-review declined
清空终端并新建对话: Clear the terminal and start a new conversation
导入 Claude Code 配置与对话: Import Claude Code settings and conversations
选择或隐藏终端宠物: Choose or hide the terminal pet
下次启动的终端界面: Terminal interface for the next start
补充说明（可选），按 Enter 随所选答案一起提交: Notes (optional); Enter submits them with the chosen answer
界面更清晰：壁纸统一压暗降噪，每张卡片是一块深色磨砂玻璃，正文白色、标题青绿；你: Clearer to read: the wallpaper is darkened and smoothed, every card is a pane of dark frosted glass with white text and teal titles, and your prompts, tool calls, code and options each sit on their own light card.
字体边缘按系统和屏幕分辨率优化：普通和 150% 缩放的屏幕用清晰的硬边，高分屏: Text edges are tuned for each system and screen: standard and 150% screens get crisp edges, high-density screens stay soft, and the glass blur adapts too.
Claude Code 和 Codex（Plan 模式）向你提问时，阅读视图直接: When Claude Code or Codex (Plan mode) asks you a question, the reading view shows it as a card: pick, tick several, type your own answer or notes, and submit there.
语音输入可选“高精度 · 中英混合”模型（Qwen3-ASR，约 985 MB）: Dictation can use a high-accuracy model for mixed Chinese and English (Qwen3-ASR, about 985 MB), noticeably better on mixed speech; the current model keeps working while it downloads.
阅读视图空闲时不再显示状态行；Windows 上偶尔被占用而保存失败的文件会自动: The reading view shows no status line while idle; on Windows, a save refused for a moment by another program is retried; slash command lists match the latest Claude Code and Codex.
回答已换行，请切换到终端修改后提交。: This answer wraps over several lines; change it in the terminal and submit there.
